newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 23.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

Wanstead couple Anna and John Woolnough are to sue Whipps Cross Hospital in east London, after their baby son, conceived after extensive treatment for infertility, suffered severe brain damage during his birth. The baby was starved of oxygen for 25 minutes during his birth on 2 December.

Whitbread has withdrawn its bid for Granada's Welcome Break motorway service stations, which it had agreed to buy last year in a one billion pounds stg deal which included Travel Lodge and Litte Chef. Granada's main interest was in developing the Travel Lodge and Little Chef businesses, and it has also spent 160 million pounds stg on food-led companies like Cafe Rouge, Pelican Group and BrightReasons, as a way of expanding its restaurants business.

Asian trading saw the dollar fall against both the Japanese yen and the Deutschmark. The run-up to Christmas and celebration of Emperor Akihito's birthday in Tokyo caused trading to be thinner than usual.
